description: This file implements the TraceControl plugin for the WPEFramework, handling trace logging, configuration, initialization, deinitialization, and web interface interactions.

classes.name: TraceControl
classes.description: Main class implementing the trace control plugin, managing configuration, states, and communication.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer
classes.description: Observer class for monitoring trace settings and modules.

classes.name: TraceControl::Data
classes.description: Data structure holding trace configuration information.

methods.name: TraceControl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up configuration, output channels, and starting observation.

methods.name: TraceControl::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops observation, and unregisters the plugin.

methods.name: TraceControl::Process
methods.description: Handles web requests to get or set trace states via HTTP methods.

methods.name: TraceControl::Dispatch
methods.description: Outputs trace information to configured output channels.
